posts.caption_text: Day 1 of actually showing up for myself. Recorded my first workout video today and I'm equal parts proud and mortified.
Not gonna lie, today's leg day almost broke me. Ten more reps than I wanted to do but I did them.
Question I get a lot: no, I don't follow a strict meal plan. I just try to eat real food most of the time.
Filmed this one in my actual living room because the gym was packed. Improvise, right?
Someone asked what keeps me consistent. Honestly? Just not overthinking it and showing up anyway.
New personal record on deadlifts today and I definitely yelled a little too loud.
Rest day. My body earned this couch.
One month into posting these and I still get nervous hitting upload. Doing it anyway.
